metaShifts.description: With armor itemization systematically weakened in 7.35b, this patch pivots toward evasion as the primary defensive mechanic. Talisman of Evasion (+5% evasion), Heaven's Halberd (+5% evasion), and Radiance (+5% evasion) buffs, combined with BKB magic resistance increase (50% to 60%), establish evasion + magic resistance as the new defensive meta, replacing the collapsed armor ecosystem.

Massive cost reductions across intelligence itemization: Kaya (-50g), Bloodthorn (-200g), Orchid (-200g), Dagon cooldown buffs, and Khanda damage increase (+50) create unprecedented value for spell-based cores. This directly counters 7.35b's spell amplification nerfs by making intelligence items more accessible and impactful.

Systematic buffs to status resistance across Sange-based items: Sange (+4% status resistance), Sange and Yasha (+5%), Kaya and Sange (+5%) create a new defensive layer. Combined with evasion buffs, this establishes a dual-defensive paradigm where heroes can avoid both physical damage (evasion) and control effects (status resistance).

Core support items face severe cost increases: Shiva's Guard (+350g), Mage Slayer (+200g), Parasma (+400g), while neutral item nerfs (Safety Bubble, Fairy's Trinket, Arcane Ring) reduce early game power. This forces supports into more expensive, less accessible itemization paths, widening the gap between core and support farm priority.

synergisticWinners.synergyExplanation: PA's agility gain buff (+0.2) combined with Sange item buffs (status resistance increases, cost reductions) creates a perfect storm. PA can now build Heaven's Halberd or Sange and Yasha for enhanced survivability through evasion stacking and status resistance, while her improved Stifling Dagger range synergizes with the tempo-oriented itemization.

Leshrac's Diabolic Edict damage buff (+1/2/3/4 per explosion) and Pulse Nova mana cost reduction combine perfectly with the intelligence item cost reductions (Kaya -50g, Bloodstone +3 mana regen). The cheaper access to mana sustain items amplifies his already buffed damage output, making him a dominant mid-game core.

TB's base strength buff (+2) and Reflection cooldown reduction (-2/2/2/2s) align perfectly with the evasion-based defensive shift. TB can now build Radiance (buffed evasion) or Heaven's Halberd for survivability while his improved early game presence capitalizes on the faster, tempo-oriented meta established by cheaper intelligence items.

Omniknight's Repel pure damage immunity fix combined with BKB's magic resistance increase (50% to 60%) creates unprecedented magic immunity synergy. Teams can layer Repel and BKB for near-complete magical damage negation, while the status resistance meta buffs make dispelling these effects much harder.

synergisticLosers.synergyExplanation: Lion's Earth Spike cooldown nerf (+3/2/1/0s) and Mana Drain nerfs combine disastrously with Mage Slayer's increased accessibility (despite cost increase, the meta shift toward it). Lion's reduced disable frequency makes him vulnerable to the debuff duration, while his weakened Mana Drain provides less protection against physical cores who can now afford Mage Slayer.

Void's base armor nerf (-1) and Time Lock creep duration removal occur precisely as evasion becomes the dominant defensive mechanic. His farming efficiency drops while enemy cores gain evasion-based survivability that his physical damage struggles to penetrate. The meta shift away from armor (which he could ignore with MKB) toward evasion directly counters his damage profile.

Arc Warden's strength nerfs (base -2, gain -0.2) and Spark Wraith duration reduction (-29s) coincide with support itemization becoming more expensive. His clone's inability to benefit from the cheaper intelligence items while supports struggle to afford detection and utility items creates a perfect storm of vulnerability for his split-push style.

Doom's ultimate duration nerf (-4/-2/0s) and movement speed reduction occur as status resistance becomes widely accessible through Sange items. His signature disable becomes significantly less effective against cores building Sange and Yasha or Kaya and Sange, while his reduced mobility makes him less effective at initiating on these now more resistant targets.

Carry.explanation: Agility gain increase (+0.2) and Stifling Dagger range buff (150/100/50/0 additional range) perfectly align with the evasion meta and cheaper Sange items. Can build Heaven's Halberd for evasion stacking while benefiting from status resistance, creating a tanky, mobile carry that thrives in the tempo-oriented meta.

Base strength increase (+2) and Reflection cooldown reduction (-2/2/2/2s) provide crucial early game survivability and fighting presence. Benefits massively from the evasion meta through Radiance builds while the status resistance buffs help him survive long enough to transform team fights with Sunder.

Mid.explanation: Diabolic Edict damage buff (+1/2/3/4 per explosion) and Pulse Nova mana cost reduction combine with the intelligence item cost revolution. Cheaper Kaya and Bloodstone access enables earlier power spikes, while his AoE damage profile counters the evasion meta by dealing magical damage that bypasses physical mitigation.

Repel pure damage immunity fix creates a legitimate mid core option in the magic-heavy meta. Benefits from cheaper intelligence items for mana sustain while providing team-wide magic immunity that synergizes perfectly with the enhanced BKB magic resistance, creating layered magical protection.

Offlane.explanation: While his Elder Dragon Form received minor nerfs, DK benefits enormously from the defensive meta shift. Can build Heart of Tarrasque (+5 strength buff) for raw HP or pivot to evasion items, while his natural magic resistance synergizes with the BKB enhancement trend, making him nearly unkillable in team fights.

SoftSupport.explanation: Divine Favor mana cost addition (75 mana) is actually a buff as it enables mana-based interactions and item synergies. Benefits from cheaper intelligence items and Vladmir's Offering buffs (+2 armor, +0.75 mana regen) while his healing counters the tempo-oriented meta by extending team fight duration.

HardSupport.explanation: Death Ward Aghanim's Scepter losing True Strike is actually beneficial in the evasion meta, as it forces enemies to invest in evasion counters rather than raw damage. His magical damage profile bypasses the evasion defensive layer while benefiting from cheaper intelligence items for mana sustain.

Carry.explanation: Base armor nerf (-1), Time Lock creep duration removal, and talent nerfs (-10 damage, -15 attack speed) occur precisely as the meta shifts toward evasion-based defense. His physical damage struggles against evasion while his farming efficiency drops, making him unable to compete with the tempo-oriented carries that benefit from cheaper itemization.

Spirit Bear movement speed nerfs (-40/-30/-20/-10) and cooldown increase (+30/20/10/0s) cripple his split-push potential while the meta shifts toward team fighting. The evasion meta doesn't benefit his bear-based damage, and the support itemization crisis means less detection for his split-push style.

Mid.explanation: Strength nerfs (base -2, gain -0.2) and Spark Wraith duration reduction (-29s) devastate his laning and farming patterns. Cannot benefit from the intelligence item buffs on his clone, while the evasion meta counters his physical damage profile. The support itemization crisis also reduces detection availability for his split-push.

Essence Flux Aghanim's Scepter nerf (-5% max mana barrier) continues the systematic weakening from 7.35b. While intelligence items are cheaper, his late-game scaling approach conflicts with the tempo-oriented meta, and the status resistance buffs reduce his disable effectiveness.

Offlane.explanation: Doom duration nerf (-4/-2/0s), movement speed reduction (-1% per level), and talent nerf (-3 Scorched Earth damage) occur as status resistance becomes widely accessible. His signature ultimate becomes significantly less effective against Sange-building cores while his reduced mobility hurts his initiation potential.

Flamethrower damage nerf (-10 DPS) and talent adjustment reduce his team fight impact while the meta shifts toward evasion-based defense that his pure damage cannot bypass as effectively. The support itemization crisis also means less detection for his mobility-based playstyle.

SoftSupport.explanation: Magic Missile cooldown nerf (+1/1/1/1s) and Wave of Terror damage reduction (-25/-20/-15/-10) occur as support itemization becomes more expensive. Her reduced disable frequency and damage output make her less effective in the faster, tempo-oriented meta while struggling to afford necessary items.

Malefice cast range nerf (-150/-100/-50/0) reduces his initiation potential while the support itemization crisis makes it harder to afford Blink Dagger. The evasion meta also reduces his team fight impact as his physical damage followers struggle against evasion-building cores.

HardSupport.explanation: Earth Spike cooldown nerf (+3/2/1/0s) and comprehensive Mana Drain nerfs (-5% movement modifier per level, Shard magic resistance -20%, break distance -200) devastate his impact. The support itemization crisis makes it harder to afford necessary items while his reduced disable frequency hurts in the tempo-oriented meta.

Borrowed Time cooldown nerf (+10/10/10s) occurs as the meta becomes more tempo-oriented and team fight focused. His reduced ultimate availability makes him less reliable as a save support while the support itemization crisis limits his ability to afford necessary utility items for his team.
